name: hero
title: Hero
description: The opening section of a website page: a big headline, a sentence and what to do next, over a moving decoration in the brand's colours. Follows the page's light or dark scheme, or stays dark with scheme="dark". Styles: aurora, orbit, gallery.

examples.name: hero-demo
examples.title: Aurora
examples.description: variant="aurora" (the default): soft lights in the brand's colours drift behind centred text. Eyebrow, a two-tone headline, a sentence and two buttons.

examples.name: hero-orbit
examples.title: Orbit
examples.description: variant="orbit": the copy on the start side; rings of the brand colour ripple out around the actions, which become a white pill.

examples.name: hero-gallery
examples.title: Gallery
examples.description: variant="gallery": your images on a slowly turning wall between the headline and the description. Two cards are brand-colour tiles.

examples.name: hero-search
examples.title: With a search
examples.description: actions takes anything: here a search field and its button.

examples.name: hero-dark
examples.title: Always dark
examples.description: scheme="dark" keeps the brand's dark colours, so the lights glow even on a light page.

props.name: titleSecondary
props.description: A second headline line in the muted text colour.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences under the headline.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A small line above the headline, such as an Eyebrow or a "what's new" Badge and Link.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons, a search field or chips. At most two buttons reads best.

props.name: variant
props.description: aurora: soft lights drift behind centred text. orbit: text on the start side, rings of the brand colour around the actions on the far side. gallery and cards follow (RFC-003).

props.name: images
props.description: Pictures for variant="gallery", used in order and repeated to fill 20 cards. Decorative: no alt text.

props.name: scheme
props.description: inherit: follow the page's light or dark scheme; in light the lights glow around the copy, which sits on a halo of the page colour. dark: always the brand's dark colours, so the lights glow even on a light page.

props.name: theme
props.description: With scheme="dark": the tenant id, so the hero renders dark on the server. Otherwise it's copied from the nearest themed ancestor.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Level of the headline. Use 2 or lower for a hero inside a longer page.

props.name: pauseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the pause toggle.

keyboard.action: On the pause toggle, pauses or resumes the lights.

notes: A section named by its headline (aria-labelledby).
WCAG 2.2.2: the lights loop slowly, so a pause toggle with a fixed name and aria-pressed is always shown. With reduced motion, nothing moves and the toggle is removed.

The decoration is aria-hidden. In light, the copy and the pause toggle sit on a halo of the page colour (90%, blurred at the copy's edge so it never reads as a box), so text.default and text.subtle stay at 4.5:1 over all four lights at full strength, for every tenant and 1,000 fuzz brands (hero.test.tsx; ADR-046). With scheme="dark", text and buttons use the brand's dark roles.
Two headline lines are read with a space between them.
orbit: the rings and stars are aria-hidden; the actions follow the copy in reading order. Buttons at the centre are a white pill: the scheme's lightest text-safe pair (16.8:1 measured on Vela).

do: Use one Hero per page, at the top.
Keep the headline to two short lines.
dont: Don't put more than two buttons in actions.
Don't place text over the lights outside the Hero's own copy.
